text:
A stranger can block your users' private payment by copying the proof that claims it.

This morning I went through a private stablecoin payments app on testnet, where the receiver redeems a claim ticket with a zero-knowledge proof. The proof never named the deposit it pays, so anyone could reuse a staged proof on their own deposit of the same amount. They get their own deposit back, and the real holder's redeem reverts from then on.

If you're building private payments, put the deposit's commitment in the proof's public inputs and check it on redeem. It costs no privacy, since redeem already shows which deposit it pays.

text:
Nodes DO define consensus, NOT miners.

No, BIP110 did NOT require 55% signaling for activation.

There is no "bulk of hashrate". SHA256 hashes and BLAKE2b hashes are not the same thing.

Hashrate, Core nodes, pools, and exchanges do not get to change the rules against a minority.

author: Murphychen888
quoted_text:
从3组数据，看BTC市场的真实恐慌程度

什么样的数据能体现出市场的恐慌？是看推特上大V的观点？是看评论区的风向？是看自媒体的消息？

都不是，对我来说会更关注以下3点：

1、长期持有者有没有“投降”表现（图1）？

从数据上看，有的！—— 11月5日当天，LTH转入交易所的实现亏损（LTH-RLTE）达到1.39亿美元，这是实体口径数据，有较高参考性。

我们可以看到，在近1年来只有在今年2月和6月市场最恐慌的时候，LTH-RLTE才有高于这个规模。充分说明当前市场情绪的焦虑程度。

但凡事皆有两面性：就连LTH都开始惊慌出逃时，往往都代表了“恐慌盘”的出清正在加速。

2、短期持有者是否“慌不择路”？

从数据上看，没有！—— STH的恐慌盘在今年1-2月就已完成大部分的清理（换手），到6月BTC甚至跌破6w，但也已逼不出太多的实现亏损了。

这是为什么？

因为STH在充分换手后整体成本下降，新进投资者买入后，价格没有跌出心理承受范围，多都会选择持有观望。

就像现在，他们的平均成本在$75K-76K左右，当前BTC价格正好在盈亏平衡附近，所以他们显得比较淡定。

3、链上整体实现亏损有没有越来越高？

客观来说，24小时平均链上实现亏损规模绝对值很高！尤其是10/30的币安事件和11/5美股崩盘，短时间内连续两次暴击，对市场信心打击很大。

这一点就能理解，在11/5出现了比较明显的LTH恐慌出逃行为。但好在目前，我们没有看到整体实现亏损变得越来越大。

对此，我个人理解是：BTC的投资者已经在用行为表达“不太愿意，但又不得不亏损卖出”的心理状态。

既然如此，修复情绪就需要等一个契机 —— 当人们逐渐意识到实际情况可能并没有预期的那么糟糕时。

用户只需说一句「帮我叫辆 Uber」，AI 就能识别手机屏幕，自动打开 App、点击按钮、填写信息，完成叫车、订餐、支付等操作，不需要第三方 App 专门开放 API。

今年 3 月，AGI 先后宣布与高通合作，并在联想 AI 助手 Qira 中演示相关能力。8 月，安卓联合创始人 Rich Miner 加入公司担任顾问。

AGI 的布局也不只是一个手机助手：
- AGI-0：专门训练的手机操作模型；
- AGI-RUN：端侧推理引擎，尽可能让 AI 在手机本地运行；
- 手机 MCP：让 Claude Code、Codex 等外部智能体也能直接操作安卓设备。

它的商业模式也很清晰：不造手机，而是向手机厂商提供模型、推理引擎和跨 App 操作能力，争夺下一代手机系统的 AI 入口。

有意思的是，同样的技术路线，在国内却遭遇了另一种局面。

截至 11 月 4 日，已有 170 多款 App 拒绝豆包手机助手代替用户操作，微信、淘宝、美团等均在其中。

AI 手机的竞争，可能不只是模型和硬件之争，更是 AI 能不能获得替用户操作整个互联网的权限。

对手机厂商来说，这是新的系统级入口；对 App 来说，却可能意味着用户入口和流量分发权正在被重新争夺。

text:
Google's investment in RSI seems to be paying off.

just months ago, they were the subject of jokes. now there's Argon, Carbon sits No. 1 on the AA Intelligence Index, and looks like an even stronger internal checkpoint called Kryoton.

of course it's really annoying that they release models so long after announcement that they're no longer relevant, but still, their pace is really hard to ignore.

let me remind you, Google struggled to train a Pro Gemini that would beat their Flash, and multiple of their major researchers flocked to other labs.

it's no secret that the labs are working towards RSI (sorry, nobody seems to be pacing shit), Google has been pretty clear they're working to achieve recursive self improvement:

> Brin: “we’re starting to get onto that RSI treadmill.”
> Pichai: “I would expect the next 12 months to see continued acceleration because of RSI.”

what is the strangest to me is, how did Google close the gap this quickly? even progressing through RSI requires good models to begin with, which OpenAI and Anthropic already had.

every time the AI race looks too predictable, another lab becomes the main character.

Alice Huang和老黄婚外情，被美国怀疑成女间谍。虽然真不了，不过让我想到冷战时期，苏联KGB的美女间谍“燕子”。

1950年代，KGB为了削弱法国和美国关系，曾策划一场美人计，目标是戴高乐的老朋友，法国驻苏大使德让。这些KGB女间谍的特别代号叫“燕子”。

他们先安排特工结识德让夫人，通过游艇聚会、高档晚宴、芭蕾演出，把一群作家、演员和假扮的苏联高官送进大使的社交圈。

然后非常自然的介绍了“燕子”劳拉给德让。

劳拉给自己安排了一个身份，已婚，丈夫是个脾气暴躁、嫉妒心极强的地质学家，常年在西伯利亚出差。

两人通过饭局逐渐亲近，发展成情人。而劳拉用来幽会的公寓，实际上是KGB布置好的秘密据点，隔壁就有情报人员监听。

后面的故事就很经典了。劳拉的“丈夫”突然捉奸在床，把德让暴打一顿，威胁公开丑闻。惊慌失措的德让向一位熟识的苏联高官求救，对方最终替他摆平了此事。

整个策略铺垫了2年，劳拉是KGB的，丈夫是KGB假扮的，最后救他的苏联高官，还是这个行动的总司令。

只能说，冷战结束了，AI军备竞赛开始了，但人类对“燕子”的想象力，从来没结束过。

author: teortaxesTex
quoted_text:
We’re entering the steep side of the METR task-horizon S-curve.

The published data through early 2026 still looks roughly exponential—p80 horizons (the length of skilled-human software/ML task an agent can finish with 80% success) have been doubling every few months. That’s amazing, but pure exponentials don’t last. Evaluation ceilings, scarce long-horizon demonstration data, and the messiness of real work all point toward a rollover.

I expect the measured curve to bend. My current best-guess logistic fit puts the inflection around now to mid-2027, then:
~65 hours by 2028
~550 hours by 2030
- approaching a practical plateau near 1,000–1,400 hours (~1.5–2 months of human time on tidy software tasks) by the mid-2030s

I’m open to being surprised. A strong self-improvement loop or new evaluation methods could keep the steep rise going longer and push the asymptote higher. Architectural or data bottlenecks could flatten it sooner. The current METR suite is already unreliable above ~16 h on the 50% horizon, so the next few years of measurements will be noisy either way.

The plot is the S-curve projection (green) against continued recent exponential (red). History says the green one is more likely. We’ll see.

Still this is a massive change for the benefit of humanity.

One of the biggest blockers to experimentation and innovation on Sol is distribution (or lack of).   

Put simply, if your idea doesn't fit inside the box given to you by the big infrastructure (routing, indexing, etc), then no one will find your token/idea/launchpad etc.   

Some have tried to counter this by launching a visible token (i.e via pump or wherever) and then directing that attention to their own site but that's still too high friction.   

Both the expense of building, and the skill required to do so have been reduced 90%, and we should be using this to innovate and experiment. Not just rely on a few big corps to decide what features are 'worth it'.   

So i'm building Pipeline (it will never have a token, and any potential revenue if it succeeds will be part of the @fffactoryhq ecosystem).   

Pipeline is a permissionless onchain router for new bonding curves, AMMs, launchpads etc. Creators can register their contracts with Pipeline, and infra (trading bots, terminals, charting) that has Pipeline integrated will pick them up automatically.   

Anyone that's interested in experimenting with the platform, looking to build something themselves, whether that's things to register with Pipeline, or infra built on top of it, please drop me a dm or comment here.

Currently only live on devnet as still running tests etc, will likely build a few fun AMMs/T22 hooks that can be experimented with myself to go with the mainnet launch, but anything extra built by others would be awesome (if you build your own amms, bonding curves, launchpads etc you can charge your own fees on them).

L2BEAT is now ETHBEAT, and one of the core ideas behind our mandate is disintermediation. Why does it matter?

Because disintermediation is still one of the most effective ways to protect individual freedom. Intermediaries concentrate power, which makes that power easier to abuse and also creates single points of failure that can affect millions of people.

The recent collapse of Ueno Bank in Paraguay showed this: ~3M people, about 60% of the country's adults, were locked out of their savings, wages and pensions overnight. And that is just the latest example. Before it, we've seen custodians misuse or freeze customer funds, banks turn deposits into equity, data holders expose users to governments and scammers, and more.

Ethereum's value lies in its decentralization, together with the CROPS properties (censorship resistance, open source, privacy, and security), which create a more durable form of stability when other systems come under pressure. Anyone can verify the chain using consumer hardware, independently built clients and open specifications.

ETHBEAT's mandate is to help ensure that the applications and infrastructure built on Ethereum actually forward those properties to users, rather than recreating the same intermediary dependencies we've been trying to reduce in the first place.

text:
Today begins a new chapter: I’m thrilled to be leading the newly created Formation Securities as President.

First order of business: we notified @SECgov that we intend to operate the first tokenized securities venue on @solana.

I want to take you back to the inception point of this endeavor. More than 18 months ago, @yelennyy at @SolanaFndn and @millercwl at @SolanaInstitute approached me about @orca_so representing the DeFi stack in a proposed framework to the SEC for trading tokenized stocks on a public, permissionless blockchain. That became Project Open, a coalition with @SuperstateInc and others that we submitted to the SEC’s Crypto Task Force in April 2025. We spent the next year working through the details with SEC staff.

When the SEC published the Innovation Exemption this September, it reflected much of what we proposed, including AMM trading on a public, permissionless blockchain. I started my career as an SEC intern, spent a decade working with public registrants, then nearly a half decade building a pioneering AMM on Solana. A real full-circle moment.

Tokenization is a generational upgrade to the infrastructure underpinning public markets, and a real opportunity for public companies and their shareholders. Helping issuers understand it is a responsibility I take seriously, and I look forward to engaging with every company considering the opportunity.

Years ago I helped take @PhillipsEdison public. I know what it’s like inside a public company legal department when a random proposal lands in the mailbox. The Formation Securities team will work to make tokenization easy for issuers to understand, and we’re committed to building this market together.

For issuers, it means a market for their stock that’s open 24/7, trades that settle atomically and a real-time view of trading in their shares. Their transfer agent keeps the shareholder register, and their shareholders keep their voting and dividend rights.

We’re building on Orca’s AMM, which has run on Solana since 2021. Traders have moved more than $550B through it, @Certora formally verified the code, and four independent firms have audited it 11 times.

@Exodus ($EXOD), @FWDind ($FWDI) and @galaxyhq ($GLXY) are among the earliest adopters, and their tokenized shares are expected to be available when trading begins in early 2027.

This is just the starting line. I’m grateful to the coalition that got us here and the issuers who said yes early. Much more to come!

Learn more: https://t.co/iSVFKov3fB

text:
「Hyperliquid市場における暗号資産Perpetual先物のファンディングレートキャリー戦略」を発表しました。

ファンディングレート（FR）が高い銘柄をショートし、低い銘柄をロングするFRキャリーは、銘柄間のFR差が持続していても、高FR銘柄の相対的な値上がりによる損失がFR収入を上回ることがあるが、モメンタムと組み合わせることで収益化が可能！という研究です。

こちらの研究です。
市川 佳彦, 中川 慧, Hyperliquid市場における暗号資産Perpetual先物のファンディングレートキャリー戦略, 人工知能学会第二種研究会資料（金融情報学研究会）, 2026, 2026 巻, FIN-037 号, p. 168-177, https://t.co/Ct9OMuc3iH

【概要】
Perpetual先物（無期限先物）では、FRがロングとショートの間で決済されます（正のFRではロングがショートへ支払い、負のFRでは逆）。本研究では、FRを毎時決済するオンチェーン取引所Hyperliquidの28銘柄で、Perpetualだけで構成したドルニュートラルなFRキャリーを分析しました。銘柄間のFR差から得られる収入が、相対価格の変化と売買コストを反映した後にどれだけ残るかを検証しています。

【FRキャリーの損益構造】
FRのインカム収入を得る一方、銘柄間の相対価格リスクを負います。高FR銘柄が低FR銘柄より上昇すればショート側に損失が出ます。現物ヘッジ付きのキャリーと異なり、このリスクは残ります。
・2銘柄の例：予想FR支払率の差をΔf（>0）、予想相対価格リターンをκΔfとすると、予想トータルリターンは(1−κ)Δf。κ>1なら価格損失がFR収入を上回ります。
・これを多銘柄へ一般化し、ドルニュートラル・グロス2の下でシグナル対リスク比を最大化するポートフォリオの解析解を導きました。この解では全銘柄に共通するFR成分が相殺され、銘柄間のFR差だけがキャリー機会を決めます。
・平均分散型（MV）と分位型のポートフォリオがFR調整に異なる反応を示す条件も導きました。

【データと設計】
・2026年8月の取得時点で出来高上位に入り、2024年1月以降の共通履歴を持つ28銘柄。
・全期間サンプル：8時間足、2024年2月19日〜2026年8月2日の約2.4年。直近サンプル：1時間足、2026年1月17日〜8月3日の約6.5か月。
・シグナルは過去30日の平均価格リターンμと平均FRの合成「μ−λ×平均FR」。λ=0は価格モメンタムのみ、λ→∞は純FRキャリーに対応します。
・主な分析対象はMVのドルニュートラル・ポートフォリオ（MV DN、日次更新）。比較対象は、上位半数を均等ロング・下位半数を均等ショートする分位ポートフォリオなどです。

【FRの分布と持続性】
・毎時FRの標本平均を年率換算し28銘柄で平均すると11.5%。負のFRの比率は銘柄ごとの比率の中央値で約20%です。
・毎時FRの1次自己相関は銘柄中央値で0.883（半減期は約6時間）。
・30日平均FRの銘柄順位の相関は1日後0.993、7日後0.922、30日後でも0.595。クロスセクション標準偏差は年率換算で11.3%に達し、過去30日のFRから銘柄間の順位を安定して推定できます。

【結果1：FRキャリーの損益分解】
・全期間・費用控除前の年率リターンは、MV DNが+8.2%（λ=0）、+8.5%（λ=1）と正だった一方、純FRキャリーはMVで−2.9%、分位で−4.0%と負でした。
・MVの純FRキャリーの−2.9%は、FRのインカム収入+11.7%と価格リターン−14.6%から成ります。共通のFR水準は消えるため、この収入は銘柄別FRのクロスセクション差から生じています。
・価格相殺比率は14.6/11.7で約1.25。高FR銘柄の相対価格上昇による損失が、FR収入1単位当たり約1.25単位に達しました（命題1のκ>1に対応しますが、κを独立に推定した値ではありません）。
・直近サンプルの分位型純FRキャリーでは、FR部分が年率12.2ポイント、価格部分が3.5ポイントで、価格相殺比率は約−0.29。高FR銘柄のショートがFR収入と価格利益を同時に生みました。

【結果2：シグナルの予測力】
・μの予測IC（翌1日の銘柄別トータルリターンとの順位相関）は全期間−0.029、直近−0.052と負で、クロスセクション・リバーサルと整合します。
・−FR（平均FRの符号反転）の予測ICはゼロ付近です。1日当たりのFR収入は日次の価格変動より小さいためです。
・全期間のモメンタム5分位のQ5−Q1スプレッドは1日保有で+35.6%（算術年率）、30日保有で−13.5%と反転し、1日スプレッドの正の平均は少数の大幅変動日に依存しています。

【結果3：FRとモメンタムの混合】
・λ=0→1で、MV DNの年率リターンは0.3ポイント、SRは0.01の上昇にとどまりました。1バー当たりのFR調整幅は約0.013%で、μの推定標準誤差約0.28%の20分の1。この規模ではMVウェイトも近い値を取ります。
・分位ポートフォリオは年率リターンが3.1ポイント、SRが0.10上昇しました。順位境界の近くでは小さなFR調整でもロングとショートが入れ替わるためで、命題3の連続的なウェイト変化と離散的な順位交差の違いに対応します。

【結果4：共分散構造による分散投資効果】
・全期間のMV DNの年率ボラティリティは25.0%で、分位ポートフォリオの29.5%を下回りました（分散比0.715、構築法の差も含む）。
・Σ（共分散行列）だけを単位行列に置き換えた対照では年率ボラティリティが56.9%に上昇し、分散比は0.19（95%信頼区間0.16〜0.23）。直近サンプルでも0.24（同0.18〜0.35）で、両サンプルで共分散構造を利用したMV DNのほうが低い分散でした。

【結果5：売買コストへの感応度】
・基準の費用はtaker手数料4.5bpとimpact bid–ask spreadの半分（片道）。スプレッドは2026年8月12日の断面で0.53〜25.4bp、中央値4.1bp。
・MV DN（λ=1、出来高で絞った流動性制限ユニバース）の費用控除後SRは、taker基準で全期間−0.07（スプレッド3倍で−0.48）、直近+0.44。理想化maker（手数料1.5bp、スプレッド支払いなし）では全期間0.46、直近1.00でした。
・全期間で損益ゼロとなるmaker約定比率は機械的な線形混合で約14%。

【まとめ】
・高FR銘柄の相対価格上昇がFR差に対して十分に大きいと価格部分の損失がFR収入を上回り、全期間の実証結果はこの価格相殺を確認しました。
・共分散構造を利用した構築は単位行列の対照より低い分散を記録し、全期間の費用控除後成績は執行前提によって符号が変わりました。
・FRの持続性だけでは収益性を判断できず、FRのインカム収入、相対価格変動によるキャピタル損益、分散投資効果、執行費用を分けて評価する必要があります。
・適用範囲は2026年8月の取得時点で選んだ固定28銘柄と定率配分指数で、ドルニュートラルでも暗号資産市場へのベータは残ります。
FRキャリーを検討する際に、損益の内訳と執行費用まで分けて点検する一助になれば幸いです。

For decades, financial markets have operated on infrastructure designed around fixed trading hours and delayed settlement. There is no longer a technical reason for these constraints to exist. 

When we designed Avalanche, we understood that bringing global financial markets onchain would have strong requirements. Institutions need networks they can configure to their own requirements, with the ability to achieve near-instant finality without giving up control over how those networks operate.

Now, Avalanche technology is set to power the core clearing ledger for an upcoming NYSE-affiliated tokenized securities platform.

It’s incredibly gratifying to see the ideas we spent years researching and engineering find their way into the infrastructure of global finance.

text:
one thing nobody really talks about in crypto is how hard it becomes to do absolutely nothing.

you wake up and check prices

you open X to see what's happening

someone just made 50x on a memecoin, and someone else is convinced the next big narrative is starting, someone is talking about a new airdrop.

suddenly, doing nothing feels like you're making a mistake.

even when you have no good reason to trade, there's this constant feeling that you should be doing something.

researching another project, moving funds around, hunting for opportunities, checking charts for the tenth time.

and the funny thing is, sometimes the best decision you could possibly make is to close everything and walk away for a while.

but crypto has made that feel almost impossible.

we spend so much time looking for the next opportunity that we've forgotten how to enjoy the moments when we don't need to do anything at all.

text:
for the first time ever, I'm sharing everything I do across all my SaaS to rank on Google and get mentioned by AI

every SEO and AEO lesson I've learned is here:

1. we show up in Reddit threads. AI pulls a lot of its answers from Reddit, so Bazzly finds the threads that are fresh, and even the ones already ranking on Google, and gets our products into the top reply

2. we get our products listed #1 in listicles that already rank on Google, with Outrank. when someone asks ChatGPT for the best tool, those are the pages it reads

3. we turn Reddit questions into blog articles. Bazzly shows us what people actually ask, and we feed those questions to Outrank

4. I regularly sit down and find new niches where our products could be useful. I research each one and feed it to Outrank, and Outrank finds new ones on its own too, so our keyword plans keep expanding into new markets

5. we publish an SEO article on our own blogs every day, also with Outrank

6. Outrank helps us refresh old articles regularly. AI and Google both prefer recent pages, so every page has to stay current

7. we build new backlinks every week with Outrank, and every placement gets verified. we also pitch guest posts using Outrank's free guest post database of 278 checked sites, all DR 20+

8. we regularly ship extremely useful free tools for potential users, and each one ranks on Google and brings people into our products

9. every month we check which AI answers name our products and which don't

Outrank's AI Visibility Checker asks ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity real buyer questions, then shows whether we got named, which competitors did, and which sources got cited

we feed those sources back into Bazzly, Outrank and our internal social content

all of this brings in new users, and then we run loops that turn them into champions who spread the word

10. we incentivize our users to share honest reviews of our products on Instagram, TikTok, X and LinkedIn, and on public review sites

11. we let our users become affiliates, and then we help them make better content about our products. in the last 30 days, ~$8K has been generated by Revid affiliates alone

basically every SEO and AEO lesson I learn building Outrank and Bazzly goes straight into every product I run

and the idea behind all of it is simple

AI recommends the most mentioned product

so we make sure every one of our products gets mentioned everywhere Google and AI look: all sorts of blogs, listicles, Reddit, review sites and social

and this setup does the job extremely well, for every product we run

text:
NOVA Blueprint Update: Nesso-1 & Antitarget Scoring

We’re upgrading NOVA Blueprint with Nesso-1 as its new oracle model, replacing Boltz-2, and reintroducing antitarget scoring to reward molecules with stronger predicted binding selectivity.

Why it matters:

• Higher throughput: Nesso-1 enables significantly faster binding affinity predictions, allowing miners to evaluate more molecules and explore chemical space more efficiently within the same competition time budget.

• Greater selectivity: Reintroducing two antitarget proteins encourages algorithms to identify molecules that bind strongly to the intended target while minimizing predicted binding to undesired proteins.

The first competition will establish a new champion in a single round, with a bounty capped at one day’s emissions. Standard competition rules resume afterward.

The oracle is open source, so miners can run their own benchmarks and testing. We’ll also publish performance metrics for our selected hardware.

Rollout: November 9 | Epoch 20767

text:
AN ENTIRE UNDERGROUND CITY BENEATH OUR FEET. 🇹🇷

What I saw at Derinkuyu in Turkey gave me a deeper appreciation for the ingenuity of the people who built and used this extraordinary place.

Carved into the rock is a network of chambers and narrow passageways, with ventilation shafts, wells, food storage areas, and massive circular stone doors that could close off passages for protection. The planning behind a place like this deserves serious attention.

Think about what living underground requires. Air has to circulate. Water has to remain accessible. Food needs to be stored. People need space to gather, rest, and worship. Every one of those needs had to be considered.

Derinkuyu served as a refuge, and seeing it brings the human side of that history into focus. Imagine taking your family below ground and depending on these spaces for shelter and survival.

For me, this is where exploring the past becomes powerful. You begin asking questions about the people behind the construction: How did they organize the work? How did their knowledge develop? What can the spaces they left behind teach us about their lives?

Our ancestors’ ability to adapt, build, and solve difficult problems deserves our curiosity and respect. There is so much to learn when we take the time to look closely.

Would you explore Derinkuyu and walk into this underground chapter of human history? 👇🏾

#BillyCarson #4biddenknowledge #Derinkuyu #Turkey #Cappadocia #AncientEngineering #UndergroundCity

ran my own eval, claude code fable 5.1 high vs codex gpt6-astra high playing codename on nightmare difficulty.

For decades, financial markets have operated on infrastructure designed around fixed trading hours and delayed settlement. There is no longer a technical reason for these constraints to exist. 

When we designed Avalanche, we understood that bringing global financial markets onchain would have strong requirements. Institutions need networks they can configure to their own requirements, with the ability to achieve near-instant finality without giving up control over how those networks operate.

Now, Avalanche technology is set to power the core clearing ledger for an upcoming NYSE-affiliated tokenized securities platform.

It’s incredibly gratifying to see the ideas we spent years researching and engineering find their way into the infrastructure of global finance.

Galxe is consolidating its team and brand under Gravity to accelerate the development and adoption of Gravity L1.

Over the past five-plus years, we’ve helped pioneer Web3 questing and given projects new ways to connect with users and build communities. We’ve served 36 million users and supported more than 7,700 partner projects through campaigns, credentials, and loyalty programs, helping people discover new projects, contribute to their ecosystems, and earn recognition and rewards. We’re bringing that experience and the relationships built along the way into our work on Gravity.

As part of this consolidation, we will wind down Galxe Quest, Galxe ID, Galxe Passport, and related services. Gravity will continue operating as usual, with no changes to the G token as part of this transition.

Starting today, Spaces can no longer create new campaigns. New Galxe+ and Galxe Score subscriptions and Galxe Passport minting are also no longer available.

December 5, 2026, will be the last day to participate in campaigns. No campaigns will remain active after that date. On December 15, 2026, campaign reward claims will close, and the entire Galxe website will switch to read-only mode. Please claim any outstanding campaign rewards before December 15.

User assets remain safe, including Smart Savings balances, staked G that has not yet been withdrawn, and G tokens held in wallets on Gravity Alpha Mainnet. These assets will follow a separate claim process and timeline. We will publish the details and instructions in a follow-up announcement on our official X.

Thank you to the users, builders, and partners who helped shape Galxe. We look forward to continuing to build with you on Gravity.

quoted_text:
Today begins a new chapter: I’m thrilled to be leading the newly created Formation Securities as President.

First order of business: we notified @SECgov that we intend to operate the first tokenized securities venue on @solana.

I want to take you back to the inception point of this endeavor. More than 18 months ago, @yelennyy at @SolanaFndn and @millercwl at @SolanaInstitute approached me about @orca_so representing the DeFi stack in a proposed framework to the SEC for trading tokenized stocks on a public, permissionless blockchain. That became Project Open, a coalition with @SuperstateInc and others that we submitted to the SEC’s Crypto Task Force in April 2025. We spent the next year working through the details with SEC staff.

When the SEC published the Innovation Exemption this September, it reflected much of what we proposed, including AMM trading on a public, permissionless blockchain. I started my career as an SEC intern, spent a decade working with public registrants, then nearly a half decade building a pioneering AMM on Solana. A real full-circle moment.

Tokenization is a generational upgrade to the infrastructure underpinning public markets, and a real opportunity for public companies and their shareholders. Helping issuers understand it is a responsibility I take seriously, and I look forward to engaging with every company considering the opportunity.

Years ago I helped take @PhillipsEdison public. I know what it’s like inside a public company legal department when a random proposal lands in the mailbox. The Formation Securities team will work to make tokenization easy for issuers to understand, and we’re committed to building this market together.

For issuers, it means a market for their stock that’s open 24/7, trades that settle atomically and a real-time view of trading in their shares. Their transfer agent keeps the shareholder register, and their shareholders keep their voting and dividend rights.

We’re building on Orca’s AMM, which has run on Solana since 2021. Traders have moved more than $550B through it, @Certora formally verified the code, and four independent firms have audited it 11 times.

@Exodus ($EXOD), @FWDind ($FWDI) and @galaxyhq ($GLXY) are among the earliest adopters, and their tokenized shares are expected to be available when trading begins in early 2027.

This is just the starting line. I’m grateful to the coalition that got us here and the issuers who said yes early. Much more to come!

Learn more: https://t.co/iSVFKov3fB

anthropic is $1,380 on binance and $1,618 on entropy. looks like a free 17% arb. it isn't, and most anthropic "spreads" across its 31 markets aren't either

there is no spot anthropic, so every venue has to make up a price somehow. four ways

1. binance quotes a per-share price with an assumed 1b shares, and its pre-ipo index is the average of its own trades over the last 10 seconds. mexc, @Aster_DEX , @grvt_io , blofin, phemex, bingx, htx, @variational_io , @edgeX_exchange , @TxFlow_L1 , aevo, @nadoHQ , @QFEX , sunx, azverse and apex sit on binance's price: all 17 at $1,378–1,381, eight of them with the identical +0.005%/8h funding, 11 of them under $500k oi

2. deribit 1,388, okx 1,389, kraken 1,394, bybit 1,397, kucoin 1,398, bitget 1,405 and gate 1,414 run their own index. kraken keeps its mark within 0.25% of its own pre-ipo valuation index. @cryptocom  s index is 50% okx + 50% gate. the others don't publish the method

3. lighter 1,600, lighter rh 1,609, polymarket 1,612, entropy 1,618 and phoenix 1,618 quote market cap in billions, 1 point = $1b. none of them publishes an external price feed: the price is what traders on that venue agree on

4. @tradexyz  quotes one real share: xyz:ANT references 1 class a share of anthropic, expected nasdaq ticker ANT, $99 now with $72m oi. before the ipo the mark comes from its own order book only, and funding is set to 1% of normal. on listing it converts to a regular equity perp. paragon and extended quote the same $99. this is the only one of the four tied to a real share price, and the ipo is expected on november 20

so why don't 1,380 and 1,618 converge? the unit is the same, $1b of market cap. but there is no spot and no delivery, funding is capped near zero, and at the ipo every venue converts by its own rules. nothing pulls two isolated pools of traders together until then

the only like-for-like gaps are bitget (1.8%) and gate (2.5%) vs binance. bitget has $15m oi, gate's book is thin. and in 11 days xyz:ANT finds out what a share is actually worth

20% spread between Lighter RH and Variational

This was the situation with the Anthropic pre-IPO market.

The spread started widening yesterday, hovering around 8%, but today it peaked at roughly 20% before narrowing back to around 10%.

As I understand it, this was driven, at least in part, by the following announcement from Lighter:

https://t.co/k5KRROQBMS

Lighter calculates the contract using the fully diluted share count, including employee stock options and other securities that may eventually convert into shares.

Binance and other exchanges haven’t announced a similar approach.

Since Variational’s price is based on Binance, the difference in how these contracts are valued appears to have caused the spread between the platforms to widen rapidly.

The spread could persist until the markets align on how Anthropic’s share count should be calculated, or until traders reprice the difference.

That’s how I understand the situation, but I may be missing something. Feel free to correct me.

这里写对科技美股的产业一手信息判断，对加密和AI结合叙事的观察，也写我们如何被大脑激素裹挟不理智交易，和如何利用脑科学知识摆脱裹挟做对投资决策。

CCR的缘起是一个北大老同学炒股炒币群，从疫情期间狗狗币第一次破圈，一直到去年的半导体，今年的光模块，大家输出自己周围人或所在行业shop talk的内容，取得了一个小群体里的“价值情报网络”，和难得的“有效利他主义”实践。

交换了解全球最聪明/离钱或产业最近的圈子信息这件事，让我想起了我的第一份工作。我曾短暂地在一家咨询公司服务华尔街风头最盛的两家对冲基金，做的事情和我们现在做的非常相似:

1. 十年前的华尔街对冲基金是怎么 “合规” 提前拼出财报的

听着玄乎其实非常简单：财报发布前四到六周，对冲基金雇佣一家咨询公司做商业尽职调查（CDD)，咨询公司再去市场打“专家电话”（expert call）。

以曾经的牛股海天味业为例，咨询公司目标找到各大区、各省区的在职或刚离职的经理，通过招聘网站或第三方公司的专家库找到目标的“专家”。通过一小时几百美金的咨询费，聊以下问题：这个月你区域的出货节奏怎么样、经销商打款是提前还是压后、KA 渠道的费用什么时候确认、竞品在这个价格带做了几次促销、库存周转是三十天还是四十五天。

几十通电话打完后，收入、毛利率、费用率就清楚了。通过一套excel 搭建模型，将同比增速拼出一个区间，算出来的财报误差常常在正负个位数以内。

这样一来，相比于KOL和普通人，对冲基金付出小几十万美金就能提前知道财报内容，提前开单获取上亿美金的收益。

游戏，互联网等行业的上市公司同理，如果你在上述行业工作过，你很可能接到过这样所谓的“专家访谈电话”。是不是觉得自己可能值更多钱哈哈！

八年前这套东西叫 “专家网络”（expert network）；今天它换了个更体面的名字，叫 “另类数据”，或者 “基本面研究外包”，继续被机构采购。看到X上很多博主在赌财报，不知道他们的信息来源是否像上述一样可靠。

很巧合的是，最近几年的热点行业，CCR的成员都有在头部公司工作，或在金融机构覆盖这个行业的研究（也印了那句清北学生到哪个行业，哪个行业就快到顶了，美女也同理）。

我们看到Citrini的天才研究员们把自己的insight呈现给市场，我们也想找个方式，参与进这场浩浩荡荡的时代潮流中。

2. 财富的代际转移，与桶里的螃蟹

早期的CCR群里，最反对币圈的，是做题做得最好的那几个家人。

这件事我看了很久才想明白：他们不是没看懂，是厌恶，厌恶的是 “这么low的一群人凭什么赚到钱”。

这种情绪在英文里有个不太好听的对应词，叫 meritocratic contempt—— 信分数排序的人，对没通过排序却先富起来的人的敌意。它比单纯的嫉妒更硬，因为它自带道德优越感。

离得越近的人，越不愿意看见你赚钱。这个现象有个很准确的英文说法，crab mentality，螃蟹心理。桶里的螃蟹，谁往上爬，其余的就会把他拽回来。不是因为他爬错了，而是因为他爬出去了。

我作为18年入圈工作的中早期参与者，前期劝说他们加入，后期制止他们FOMO，我发现，比早期 “他们讨厌” 更值得写的是市场加热期的另一件事：

我们站在行业中心看到的，和市场定价的，差得非常远。

加密货币是这样，半导体是这样，光模块更是这样。在产线上、在供应链里、在交易所里，你知道这个季度到底发生了什么；然后你打开盘面，看见一个比现实更夸张的数字。此时金融市场进入了靠幻想支持的泡沫期，即超买FOMO期。《乌合之众》里讲，人一旦进入群体，智力会降级，情绪会传染，暗示变得极容易接受。

比特币，AI股票，宗教等等，都是人类的群体幻觉。这种幻觉会像田野里的麦穗一样闻风而动，又像多米诺骨牌一样树倒猢狲散，周而复始。

那怎么办。

我们的答案是：趁早看清并参与每一轮革命，哪怕你不信它，再趁早从革命中抽身，哪怕你留恋他。

革命这个词现在被用烂了，但它的本质很朴素 —— 财富的代际转移。

新的生产资料被发明出来，旧的分配渠道被改写，钱换一批人拿。算力、数据、链上流动性、模型权重，是这一轮的新生产资料；谁手里握着，谁就能重新分一次。旧钱只是换了持有者，变成了新钱。

幸亏这些话我这五年，在群里一直说lol。

3. 和湾区工程师聊基座和后训练，聊出了交易时的脑科学

年初的一天，我想搞懂 base model 和 post-training 到底差在哪，找到了个在湾区的 AI 工程师的双学位老同学请教。

他讲到一半我发现不对劲 —— 我们聊的不是模型，是脑子。

基座模型做的事是极其纯粹的: 给定前面所有 token，预测下一个。没有偏好，没有价值观，没有 “应该”。它是统计本能在规模上的极致。后训练才把 “人想要什么” 灌进去，SFT 教它照着示范答，RLHF 和 DPO 用奖励模型给它塑形。

这是在教模型明辨是非，不是教它懂语言。先天和后天，在模型这里是分开的两步。

然后是他讲的那句让我坐直的话：

多巴胺不是快乐，是误差。

也就是说，人脑和模型在最底层优化的是同一个目标函数。区别只在于人脑的奖励函数是进化写死的，模型的奖励函数是后训练时人给的。

这个类比一旦成立，交易里那些讲不清的症状全都有了解释。

赚钱的时候不止盈，不是贪。浮盈在持续供给多巴胺，一旦平仓，未来的预期误差就归零，神经系统会把 “卖出” 编码成一次惩罚。

亏钱的时候看什么都难受，是因为损失带来的心理权重差不多是同等收益的两倍。再叠上皮质醇升高和注意力窄化，视野会真的变窄。此时的我们并不理智。

FOMO 更难对付，社会性疼痛和物理疼痛共用同一套前扣带回的回路，所以 “错过” 在体感上不是少赚了一笔，是被群体甩下了。

很多时候我们没有意识到的是，我们的纪律在和大脑的神经递质抢方向盘。

我发现这种神经激素的群体化传染可以解释上文提到的群体无意识: 个体的失控会被群体放大。情绪传染、信息级联、羊群效应，说的都是这件事：

一个人的杏仁核被劫持，一群人的前额叶会一起下线。

所以你需要一套逻辑+一些诤友，甚至一个grok bot来让自己保持理智。

活着是逆熵，投资有道有术，术是说起来容易做起来难的，CCR在输出行业洞见”道”的同时，也希望能有一点人情味，我们想在这片黑暗森林里陪伴你一起解决投资——这个将伴随我们一生的课题。

To think like a pro，to trade like a hedge fund.

Introducing Arete-27B: Qwen3.8-27B, post-trained to reinforce Western values.

Chinese open models are currently the strongest available, but they ship with state-aligned behavior in the weights. We built an 803-prompt eval across seven value categories, including freedom of expression, democracy, and privacy, and measured how often a model adopts China’s party line.

After fine-tuning on roughly 53 million tokens, Arete-27B's propaganda rate fell from 22% to 1%, in line with the Western models we tested. Its Hermes Bench score shows no significant performance tradeoffs.

The values in an open model are one fine-tune away. 

Our eval, weights, and training data are available now along with the full blog post: https://t.co/iAOANQTVZ6

Participated in workshops on Frame Transactions (EIP-8141) last week. 

Great EIP. More flexibility for users is great. 
Most excited about support for different concurrent signing methods, e.g. different cryptography. Really key for PQ. 

Frame Transactions have new requirements. For example, they can be very large. 

For this reason I see much overlap with multi-party block construction. 
MPBC frequently adds a lot of gas to blocks, including transactions and blobs. 
For example, just today a block with +44.8m gas landed. Multiple blocks exceeding 20m gas added also landed. 

I think frame transactions can be great for users, and MPBC is a very efficient way of getting them included. 
Looking forward to that.

quoted_text:
Expanding on why I believe "ETH as store of value (SoV)" makes much more sense to focus on than "ETH as fee-burning token".

Three primary reasons:

1. ETH as fee-burning token never was as strong as it seemed
2. Optimizing for ETH as fee-burning token would demand Ethereum and ETH function in ways that are very hard to make compatible with decentralization and capture resistance.
3. Meanwhile, optimizing for ETH as SoV is aligned with Ethereum focusing on its unique strengths (decentralization and CROPS)

EIP-1559 (including its burn) is fine and good, we should keep them. But we should not feel sad if fee burn is < 10% of breakeven indefinitely; the value of ETH comes from elsewhere.

The core idea: the big thing that people appreciate about Ethereum is decentralization and CROPS. The main pragmatic benefit that these things translate into is stability. SoV is the category where that is not an unneeded extra we merely put effort into for ideological reasons, but rather a pragmatic strength from the perspective of people putting in their assets. And in the era of AI disruption, stability will be highly valued.

text:
I just published an essay, Financing Prometheus, on the future of DeFi in frontier industries and “after crypto”:

https://t.co/YopMklCQ2t

“After crypto” is not an exit from digital assets. It names an expanding economic purpose. Crypto remains part of the system, while repayment increasingly comes from electricity delivered, computing capacity used, goods shipped, and discoveries made useful.

The assets of that future are the claims that make this possible: equipment and facilities for intelligence, the power that sustains them, the receivables that keep commerce moving, and the milestones that carry science from a laboratory into production. These are not substitutes for tokenized Treasuries or fund shares. Representing an existing security, making it useful inside DeFi, and originating new productive credit are distinct achievements. The frontier requires all three.

A company building a computing facility may have valuable customer contracts and very little spare collateral. Somebody must evaluate those contracts, finance construction, allocate losses, and commit for an appropriate term. Putting an existing bond onchain does not perform those jobs.

DeFi’s opportunity is to organize confidence for that next industrial age: capital markets that can underwrite uncertainty, assemble entire capital structures, and give promising enterprises time to become productive.

We have no shortage of extraordinary possibilities. The work now is to put foundations under them.

Wall Street has never been particularly sentimental about legacy infrastructure when there’s a compelling economic reason to replace it. Markets have evolved before, and they’ll evolve again.

The upcoming NYSE-affiliated tokenized securities platform, built using Avalanche technology, is a significant development in that evolution.

For all the attention paid to 24/7 trading, the more consequential question has always been what happens after a trade is executed. Things like clearing, settlement, custody, and collateral mobility, are the much less glamorous mechanics of financial markets, but they’re also where most of the friction, cost, and trapped capital reside.

Blockchain offers an opportunity to fundamentally rethink that architecture at its core, rather than simply extend the operating hours of the existing one.

text:
I’ve been tied up with family issues for the last week (always happens at the worst time), so have only really been able to sit down and look at things properly today.

A few thoughts:

BTC has put in five red weeklies in a row, closed below the 50W MA, and is well within the previous range with the bottom of said range being 60k. It's been hammered with endless bad news and headlines. 

Doesn't feel great, obviously. 

In 2023 when we exited the bear market we saw a sharp drop to the 200DMA and that was bought up and we continued our ascent. We were very close to that level this morning but didn’t quite tag (maybe front run). It sits at $73.2k right now. This was a test I have been expecting as an inevitability since we had our impulse candle.

Buying the 200DMA post bear market exit (if this is that moment) is some of the best execution you could have had and a plan that could be blindly followed without letting outside bias prejudice you.

As an analyst, I can see the other side of the coin: in the context of that previous exiting of bear market moment in 2023 we didn’t have so much sustained weakness, and were above the previous point of breakdown, whereas this time we are below the May highs which is where we broke down from this year.

Not getting the push higher to the 90s has meant we have corrected back into the range, and made this look far more like a deviation rather than a strong exiting of the bear market moment.

Will the bulls step in here at/close to the 200DMA? tbc, there are juicy targets below which seem like they have a realistic shot of hitting now that you finally have indexes likely heading for multi week/multi month correction.

It is a do or die level, as nothing good happens when you accept below the 200DMA. You want to see strength and interested buyers here right now. 

The next best thing if that level fails would be a weekly close no lower than 66k to set a nice macro higher low, would also look like an inverse head and shoulders, which is a good bottoming pattern. Monthly is still bullish and painting this picture. I would very much prefer to not go lower than that. 

I still think the macro bottom is in for Bitcoin, but whenever you accept and linger in a previous range you open up the possibility of the range low hitting (60k) and if that hits, alongside mass panic, does it hold? 

To create new lows you would need a lot of forced selling to happen. Think this could only occur if Saylor gets into trouble, or something similar (always possible ofc). 

We had the set up for Bitcoin to show strength, but ultimately we have fallen back into the range on a sustained basis. This needs to reverse asap for a chance of fucking over the bears. Can't be any delays here.

Good alts will bottom first, as they have been doing. We have so few of them, so it's fairly easy to keep a small watchlist. You can simply ignore everything else. It is a total waste of time and energy and it's all legacy garbage, vapour and failed ideas. Retail and institutions are not coming to buy any of that. 

Either we bottom here, and everything looks pretty damn good in ~6 months.

Or we bottom lower, and everything looks pretty damn good in ~12 months.

I find very few assets attractive when looking forward 5 years from now due to the uncertainty that exists with AI and how long the secular bull has been going. I get the anxiety around AI/quantum for BTC (hence why I also like ZEC), but once it overcomes that it remains one of the few assets that reprices vs everything else given enough time due to sovereign fiscal irresponsibility (not something I see changing). I still see it as a cornerstone asset in a non degen portfolio for the world we currently inhabit.

We are more than a year past the top, so don’t get cute and don't overcomplicate it. Build your exposure and let time do the rest.

看了几篇Alice Huang前同学、前员工的爆料，越看越觉得不像间谍。更像一条熟悉的路：传媒出身，靠资本市场发家，最后进芯片行业做买办。

一、真间谍不会把和男方的合影发朋友圈。隐蔽工作的第一课是不留痕，而她做的恰恰相反。

二、那她和国安毫无关系？未必。但有联系和是间谍，中间隔着很远。 你在任何行业有点影响力，国安就会闻着味儿来。芯片如此，crypto 也一样：有人主动联系你，套近乎，装作只是想了解你在做什么。关系先存着，等到用你的时候再召唤。你可以拒绝——前提是你找得到保护伞，或者你已经不那么重要。我相信黄女士混到这个份上，搞个保护伞还是不成问题的。

The advancement of hardware hasn't had the same advantages as software.

@Nominal_io is working to close that gap, and that’s why we’re proud to double down and lead their $240M Series C at a $3B valuation.

Though physical AI continues to expand in applications across industries, many of the systems that support hardware engineers are not as advanced as those for software engineers, and are unable to feed into LLMs for training.

Nominal wants to create a feedback loop by collecting data from drone fleets, satellites, and other sources and unifying it in one place so their agents can help engineers analyze it.

Long after our first investment in Nominal for their Series B, they now support more than 80 commercial and government organizations, including 5 of the 7 largest defense contractors.

The co-founders, @CameronLMcCord, @jrshoch, and @brycestrauss, have deep experience in hardware engineering, and they’re motivated to make the testing process as efficient as possible by allowing AI agents to take on the work that has slowed engineers down for decades.

text:
$STONK was never just another memecoin. It was the native token of a platform @LaunchOnSF representing what could have been the ultimate evolution of the memecoin ecosystem.

For the first time, we had the opportunity to bridge two worlds: the old world of Wall Street, stocks, institutions, and finance dominated by older generations. And the new world of blockchain, decentralization, and a generation refusing to inherit the same chains.

Blockchain has become the stock market of the new generation. For Gen Z, tokens are what stocks were to previous generations. Stonk went beyond speculation. Its launch platform allowed trading fees to be used to acquire real-world stocks linked to the tokens created on it.

Think about that. Companies traditionally owned by boomers could reach younger investors through a digitalized ecosystem. Stonk wasn’t just connecting tokens to stocks. It was connecting yesterday’s shareholders with tomorrow’s investors.

Wall Street companies should have recognized this opportunity. Supporting Stonk could have helped them transition toward a world where traditional equities and blockchain-native assets coexist.

@saylor understood this evolution with $STRC (X) and his vision of digital credit. The future isn’t about separating traditional finance from blockchain, but connecting them.

And @elonmusk, you bought https://t.co/lIS9qG47F5 years ago. You once said, “Who controls the memes, controls the Universe.” What if memes could become gateways to real financial assets, connecting younger generations to the companies shaping our world? Let’s bring memes on-chain, turn cultural power into financial value, and control the universe. That’s the future Stonk envisioned.

Stonk offered memecoins a purpose beyond speculation while connecting younger generations to traditional financial assets. Not to surrender to Wall Street, but to build a bridge without belonging to it.

This reflected the spirit behind Bitcoin and Satoshi Nakamoto’s vision: freeing ourselves from dependence on a system that decides for us.

That’s why Stonk’s potential failure would mean far more than another crypto project collapsing. Another platform like $ float won’t magically replace its vision. An entire opportunity for this market could disappear with it.

Memecoins finally had something beyond hype and speculative cycles. A cultural purpose. A connection between financial generations. A gateway for traditional companies to reach new investors.

If we can’t sustain that vision, what have we built? Just the same mechanisms we wanted to escape, recreated on blockchain. The same chains. The same cages. The same power games. Just with tokens instead of stocks.

The question isn’t which platform comes next. It’s what remains of our revolution if we let Stonk die.

Because if Stonk dies, it’s not just a token or launch platform disappearing. It’s potentially the last real chance for memecoins to prove they can become more than a casino.

More importantly, we risk losing the bridge between traditional finance and the new financial world. Two worlds that should evolve together, not destroy each other. The old needs the innovation, energy, and capital of the new. The new needs the foundations and stability of the old.

Our generation could have strengthened the financial system we inherited while transforming it into something more accessible and aligned with our future.

Stonk wasn’t just about reinventing memecoins. It was about connecting two generations, two financial systems, and two worlds that could have been stronger together.

If we let that vision die, we won’t just have failed a project. We will have failed a generation.

quoted_text:
这款 西游X 不是什么币圈项目，就是我自己做的一款游戏，最开始的时候我用 Grok Bot 做一个塔防游戏做着玩的，纯粹就是为了好玩，毕竟有了十多年做游戏的底子，就做了一些有趣的设定。

游戏的本质和吸血鬼幸存者有点类似，但加入了塔防的属性，第一版的时候就是四个徒弟护送唐僧一路西行，在游戏中唐僧是不能被控制的，只能自动的一路向西走，会有大量的妖怪出现。

唐僧忠于原著没任何的战斗力，也没有武器，生命值也只有 1 ，一碰就死，所以我就想到四个徒弟作为“塔”如何保护唐僧，相当于一个逆向的塔防游戏，正常都是玩家建塔消灭路上的怪物，但我这个正好反过来。

但是跑了几篇测试觉得没什么新意，就想到应该有主动出击的环节，消灭 BOSS 可以减少怪物的数量，也能符合剧情，这种想法打开了潘多拉的盒子。

所以在游戏的设计中就有了四个徒弟可以分别操控的方案，既可以围绕在唐僧周边守护，也可以主动出击消灭怪物，还加入组合技，比如孙悟空+猪八戒一起出击的时候就能打出组合技。

比如任何角色+白龙马都可以加快移动速度，每个角色还有自己的特殊技能，比如孙悟空的筋斗云就是使用户，不论孙悟空在什么位置都可以直接瞬移到唐僧的身边。

这种玩法是有意思了，但我还是觉得缺少了什么，最重要的灵魂就是社交，我就加入了几个 X 上的小伙伴，把 X 上的小伙伴直接做到了游戏中，而且还可以自定义 X 上的角色进入到游戏里，这种玩法就有意思一些了。

最开始就加了九个特殊角色，下一个版本的时候会再加入一些，每个角色都通过 AI 计算出和发文类似的技能和属性，而且还加入了自己设计关卡的“反派模式”，我个人是觉得有意思多了。

现在还在修改一些细节，11月11日就可以公开对外测试了。

text:
Defense, space, energy, and robotics are all pulling hardware toward software-speed iteration. The teams winning in these markets ship in hours, days, and weeks, not the months and years hardware has traditionally taken.

Testing is where that pace breaks down. Test data lives in too many places and gets stitched together by hand. @nominal_io is the modern stack for this. They combine test automation, telemetry, and analysis in one place, from the first prototype through production and into operation. 

Customers’ behavior is the best evidence. Nominal was recently selected for a $71M STRATFI, and won a delivery order award through PAE’s Rapid Capabilities Cell to speed up integration and testing of Castelion’s Blackbeard on the F/A-18. These are programs where test speed decides how fast a capability reaches the field. 

Congrats to @CameronLMcCord, @jrshoch, @brycestrauss and the whole team on the Series C. We’re excited to keep partnering with them.
author: Alfred_Lin

Nominal just raised $240M at a $3B valuation.

Engineers today are building some of the most ambitious machines humanity has ever seen. They should have AI that’s purpose-built for them.

We started Nominal with a simple observation, that hardware teams needed better ways to work with test data and make decisions from it. Over the past four years, we’ve built software that understands the complex realities of hardware development. 

Now we’re building the Hardware Intelligence Platform that gives engineers increased visibility into complex physical systems, helps them make better decisions, and ultimately gets their products into the real world faster. It brings together the systems, data, intelligence, and applications hardware engineering requires to meet the AI moment.

text:
I try to use every coding model but have a hard time with those that don't have a dedicated s-tier harness. I would call codex / claude code and cursor s-tier. I use opencode as well, though not as heavily.

This has held me back a little bit from really taking Argon and Wonder for a test drive - it's hard to see what the models are capable of when you're missing a lot of the quality of life basics (robust remote control, browser control). And as the best is increasingly defined by capabilities like agent teams, the great harness+model pairs will diverge further and further from the sum-of-parts pairs.

I've heard that the best models are post-trained alongside their harnesses, and that those harnesses have more information than a vanilla harness (preserved thinking / CoT etc) - partially to avoid distillation but more importantly to capture the economic benefits of vertical integration.

Finally it seems like there's a whole emerging area of "getting the most out of the models" at the harness/agent layer. Admittedly some of this is vibes based, but the right harness + model pair is like living in the future.

A prediction market is essentially a call / put spread where the return and risk is known ahead of time. The trade off is that the payoff is capped. For 0DTE and shorter, this works great because MMs don’t have to underwrite infinite risk like a normal call option.

text:
it's funny how quickly a red market can change the way you see everything.

when prices are going up, you feel like you've figured something out.

your portfolio is growing, your decisions make sense, and even the stupid trades start looking smart.

you start thinking about quitting your job, buying a house, maybe finally taking that long vacation.

then the market turns red.

suddenly, you're questioning every decision you've made over the past few months.

that project you were so confident about? probably a mistake.

the profits you didn't take? you're an idiot.

the money you could've made if you sold earlier? you keep calculating it in your head.

and the worst part is that nothing about your life might have actually changed.

same home, same friends, same opportunities.

just a different number on a screen.

yet somehow, that number has the power to completely change how you feel about yourself.

crypto is a strange place, man.

暂时放弃 Launchpad，不急于为其他项目发行代币。专注开发可复用的 Uniswap v4 Hooks，提高 LP 收益，为协议捕获手续费收入。优先做强 SZR 自身的经济模型。

2. 新代币迁移
将部署全新合约，旧 SZR 按 1:1 迁移。
新代币固定总量 10 亿枚，不再额外增发。
预计初期流通 2–3.5 亿枚，其中约 1 亿枚用于流动性。
Floor 赎回机制保留，单位 Floor 预计不变或略有提高。

3. 全新拍卖机制
约 6.5 亿枚 SZR 计划按时间表逐步拍卖，而非一次性释放。
例如拍卖约 100 万枚，让发行价格更贴近项目当时的市场价值。
拍卖所得优先覆盖新增代币的 Floor，其余用于获取协议自有流动性。

4. Meta-Liquidity 资金飞轮
在 SZR/WETH、SZR/USDG，以及潜在的股票代币交易池中部署流动性。资金永久归协议所有，可根据交易需求在不同池子之间调配。

非 SZR 手续费兑换 WETH，直接增加储备；SZR 手续费重新进入拍卖，帮助协议获取更多流动性。

形成循环：更多流动性 → 更多手续费 → 更多储备 → 更高 Floor → 更强的 SZR 价值支撑。

5. Lending & Leverage
Floor 依然是 SZR 的核心机制。
新合约计划允许持有人基于储备权益借款。
Leverage 没有放弃，但会在流动性基础建立后再开发。

6. 当前进度
迁移合约已接近完成，仍在修改和测试。
新合约尚未正式部署，具体迁移安排待公布。

text:
Nobody will back an AI agent's loan twice if they can't get their money back.

Last week I reviewed a draft standard where a staker, a vault or an insurer can stand behind an agent's credit line and take the loss if the agent doesn't pay. In the first version, a backer that covered a default had no way to recover anything onchain, and one short payment locked it out of that lender for good.

If you're building credit for agents, decide who gets paid back first before your first default decides it for you. I'd put the backer first and the lender's fee last.

text: 跟着Jason老师学用Agent运营社媒，我几乎让Grok Bot @bot 全托管我的LinkedIn 和X了，
author: gmgnjordan
quoted_text:
我去，让 Agent 把这周 X、TikTok、Instagram、YouTube 上 80 条 AI Agent 热门内容翻了一遍

总结出 3 个规律，还把改好的 X 串推挂到了我的账号下面等我审

数据费 $0.058，发不发还是我自己点

用的是 AIsa 新上的写接口，过程和踩的坑👇

这次我把整套流程交给 Agent，自己只管看和拍板

1/ 一段话交代任务

我在 Claude Code 里跑的。AIsa 我之前就装了，第一次用的话，去 https://t.co/2BCzXDAFKd 选你用的 Agent，照页面提示装好。

发给它的是这段：

我要运营 AI Agent 主题的内容，受众是中文独立开发者和出海创作者。
用 AIsa 搜过去 7 天 TikTok、Instagram、YouTube 和 X 上相关的高互动帖子和视频，列出链接、发布时间和能拿到的互动数据，比较哪些话题和形式在这批样本里表现更好。拿不到的数据直接说，不要推断粉丝画像。
给我 3 个原创选题，挑 1 个改成 X 中文版和 LinkedIn 英文版。
然后帮我连 X 账号，把草稿和建议发布时间列给我审核，没我确认不要发。

2/ 先拉数据（读接口）

四个平台各查了两家数据源，一共 8 次调用，$0.058。

留下来用的 80 条：X 20、TikTok 30、Instagram 10、YouTube 20，都是 11 月 2 日到 8 日发的，每条带链接、发布时间和互动数。点赞最高的几条：

- TikTok：50 个 Agent 在 Minecraft 里建文明，93 万播放，6.5 万赞（11 月 4 日）
- X：@EianLu 的一篇长文，532 万浏览，3.6 万赞，7.5 万收藏（11 月 5 日）
- Instagram：一条讲 AI 工具互相配合的 Reel，近 6 万播放（11 月 4 日）
- YouTube：This ONE AI Agent Will Make You So Productive It's Almost Unfair，38 万播放（4 天前）

评论区的人也查了。X 能拿到回复者的粉丝数和简介；TikTok、Instagram、YouTube 的评论只有账号名，画像拿不到，它就直接写拿不到，没去猜。

3/ 同一条数据，两家对得上

AIsa 一个平台背后接了好几家数据源，同一个问题可以换一家再查一遍。

我拿 X 试了一下：同一条帖子，两家给的点赞都是 20,587，浏览只差 81。

4/ 三个规律，三个选题

它总结的规律，每条都能在原始数据里找到出处：

- 80 条里有 13 条讲的是一群 Agent 一起干活或一起出事，四个平台都有
- 讲故事攒赞，讲干货攒收藏。Minecraft 那条 6.5 万赞，收藏只有 8,304；"这个周末能用 AI 做的 5 件事"收藏 13,032，比赞还多
- TikTok 那 30 条里，12 条第一句就带数字

给的三个选题：

① 这周 4 个平台 80 条 AI Agent 爆款，我看出 3 个规律（数据复盘）
② 让一群 Agent 分工做一周内容，哪几步能交出去（实验故事）
③ 这个周末能用 Agent 搭的 5 个出海小工具（清单）

②和③得真跑一周、真搭一遍才写得出来，这次先选①。

5/ 同一个题，改两版

改写用的就是 Claude Code 本身。

X 中文版拆成 6 条串推：第一条直接给"80 条、3 个规律"，后面每条配一个例子，不放标签。

LinkedIn 英文版是一整篇：开头先交代样本和日期，语气像工作复盘，结尾 3 个标签。

6/ 连账号、进草稿（写接口）

这部分是 AIsa 这次新上的。

它给了我一个授权链接，我在 X 的授权页点了同意【确认：你看到的是 https://t.co/UxiZ7SgVUr 的授权页】。密码没交给它，也没为这个号单独开浏览器、配 IP。连上以后，AIsa 控制台的 Accounts 页显示 Healthy。

X 串推进了typefully草稿：状态 Draft，没排期，也没发。建议发布时间它也列给我了：X 周二晚 9 点（北京时间），LinkedIn 周二早上 8:30（美东）。

LinkedIn 这次没连，它在控制台里还标着 beta，英文版先留在文档里。

从查四个平台的数据，到改稿、进 X 草稿，都在 Claude Code 的同一段对话里做完，中间没换工具

费用：连账号、建草稿都没扣钱，真发出去才按条收，X 一条 $0.015，正文带链接 $0.20。官方说连多个账号不另收绑定费，按调用付费；我只连了一个号，确实一分没扣。

7/ 也说几个不足

- X 长帖存不进去。超过 280 字它直接报错，我的号开了 Premium 也一样，最后拆成了 6 条串推。我平时常发一两千字的长帖，这条对我影响最大。另外它数字数时中文按 1 个算，X 实际按 2 个算，每条最好控制在 140 个汉字以内
- 授权链接 30 分钟就过期，过期了点进去只显示 Connection failed，不说原因。我第一次就卡在这
- 账号跟着 API key 走，Agent 和控制台要用同一把 key，不然连上了也看不到
- Reddit 账号暂时连不上（控制台写着 Coming soon），LinkedIn、Threads、Pinterest 还是 beta
- YouTube 只给"4 天前"这种相对时间；TikTok 那 30 条里有 8 条不是英文，做英文选题要再筛一遍

8/ 适合谁

每周固定要找选题、一个题要发好几个平台的人。查数据、出选题、改写、进草稿都能交给 Agent，发不发最后还是自己点。

想试的话，先看看它能查哪些平台、能发哪些平台：https://t.co/n5ujXFuFsu

你现在每周花多少时间找选题？

text:
在美国，婚外情和出轨是相对普遍的现象。

美国出轨现象的核心统计数据
- 终身/曾经历过的出轨率： 诸如 YouGov 等机构的调查显示，在处于排他性单合伙人关系（Monogamous relationship）的美国人中，

约有 33% 的人承认自己曾出轨过（包括肉体出轨、精神出轨或两者兼有）；而大约 54% 至 63% 的人表示自己曾被伴侣背叛过。

- 已婚夫妇与恋爱伴侣： 在长期婚姻中，婚外情的直接发生率相对较低——据估计约为 20% 至 25% 的已婚人士曾有过婚外情；而在未婚的恋爱关系中，出轨率则明显更高（部分数据估计高达 70%）。

- 性别与年龄差异： 从历史数据和更广泛的数据集来看，男性报告的出轨率（约 20% 至 27%）高于女性（约 13% 至 15%）。然而，在年轻群体（18-29 岁）中，男女报告的出轨率非常接近，甚至女性的报告率略高。

- 职场因素： 研究表明，很大一部分婚外情或亲密关系始于职场环境，据估计有 30% 至 60% 的出轨事件涉及同事。

公众认知与现实的差距
- 道德谴责： 超过 80% 至 90% 的美国人认为婚外情在道德上是错误的，这表明文化上对出轨有着强烈的谴责。

- 认知的普遍性： 尽管如此，许多人仍认为出轨非常普遍。例如，美国调查研究中心（American Survey Center）的数据指出，

超过半数的年轻女性和很大一部分男性认为出轨现象极其普遍，这在一定程度上受到了文化叙事和数字媒体的放大。

quoted_text:
他还是那“一生只爱一人，只干一件事。”的黄仁勋

黄仁勋最令大家敬佩的事情，是来自一个没有什么资源的台湾家庭，在美国远超预期的完成了“美国梦”，曾寄宿很差的学校，面对种族的霸凌，只是因为便宜，从15岁起，黄在当地一家Denny's餐厅工作了五年

后来一步一脚印，成立辉达/英伟达，造就万亿美金的神话。更是难得的是，对太太的忠诚，两者相互认识于大学，一起成长，生儿育女，每天穿着太太选的皮衣。是难得的科技大佬，没有换老婆，几乎是绯闻的绝缘体。

此刻，打破了，那完美的形象，“一个人一生只爱一人，只干一件事。”  一直默默耕耘一辈子的理工男，年轻时都在奋斗，没疯狂挥霍青春，很难在功成名就的时候，不受诱惑，很多漂亮女生主动送上门，当然，不乏别有用心的人。

何况一位曾经电视台女主播/投行财富管理人员，漂亮、动人、懂人意的中国女生。在酒精的驱使下，那层纱，早就破了。他迷失了， 看看有哪个大佬不迷失过方向？ 有多少大佬要面对围猎？又有多少女生蠢蠢欲动？

刘强东也遇到过。如果此事放在马斯克那，可能大家见怪不怪。

黄并没有如成龙般，以犯下“全世界男人都会反的错”作为挡箭牌。而是公开坦诚承认错误，对太太、家人、员工公开道歉，勇气可嘉。

他管英伟达还是非常出色，能把企业带领导如此境界，为员工和投资人、业界创造了巨大的价值。

很多女生认为，男生在外风花雪月，没什么的，只要不动心。其实，还是不要。男女双方还是需要有管促，不然这关系不健康。 

“我相信黄还是爱自己的太太和家人，希望，经历这场风雨后，他们更能了解自己和彼此，错了就改。难得，这辈子一路陪伴走来，达到如此的高度， 那是亿万分之一的概率。

没有完美的人，我们都是凡人，黄仁勋作为企业家，是当之无愧的AI王者。 他实现了亚裔的成功案例，那真正的美利坚之梦。 

他还是那“一个人一生只爱一人，只干一件事。” 的黄仁勋。” - ccl

作为英伟达的股东，希望这事早点告于段落，黄能带领行业去到另外一个境界。 那才是人类之福。

希望Lori和Jensen能继续携手同行，漫步人生路。 $NVDA

text:
hi guys in case you don’t know, the worst thing that could happen to your portfolio this month might be anthropic’s IPO going GREAT

lemme explain

for 3 years you couldn’t buy openai or anthropic, so wall street dated their “friends”. the chip guy, the GPU landlord, the data center builder, and called it “ai exposure” 🤝

now anthropic reportedly kicks off its IPO roadshow THIS week. 

a month ago people were throwing around a $2T valuation. after last week’s crash some buyers are reportedly pushing for $ 1.2-1.3T, and per the financial times anthropic is ok going lower than it hoped

it’s reportedly raising $ 80-100B. at the top end that’d be the biggest IPO ever, and it’s competing for money from a lot of the same investors who already own your ai stocks

so suddenly they’re texting all the “friends” like “ok so… now that she’s single, why do i still need u?”

sure, a hot debut could lift the whole sector. but i really wanna know how much people were paying for some ai stocks bc they couldn’t buy the thing they actually wanted

well… we’re about to find out

and the “friends” have a second problem. a lot of the buildout runs on borrowed money, and borrowing just got more expensive

openai is private, but its partners’ debt trades every day. the gauge is CDS, basically insurance against a company not paying back its debt. 466bp ≈ paying roughly 4.66% of the debt a year for that insurance

levels reported late last week:

> softbank, put ~$65B into openai partly w borrowed money: touched ~466bp

> oracle, building openai’s data centers: ~298bp

> coreweave, rents out GPUs and runs on loans: ~1,155bp

(each number covers the whole company, but they’re all paying for the same buildout)

every time ai debt comes up someone says 2008 lol. 

difference is in 2008 the loans leaned on homeowners who couldn’t pay. coreweave’s lean on long customer contracts plus the GPUs themselves

so what matters is: do the customers keep paying, and what does a GPU earn when its contract ends and it needs a new tenant?

nvidia ships a new generation every 18-24 months. coreweave’s accounting assumes its GPUs earn for 6 years.

michael burry (the big short guy) argues the real economic life is more like 2-3

meanwhile coreweave has contracts for A100s, a chip from 2020, running into 2029

old chips finding work is nice. i care whether they earn back what they cost after power and interest

and in 2008 the fed cut rates to zero. this time futures were pricing ~78% odds it RAISES rates dec 9 after friday’s jobs report 😭

eyyy wait tho, back to anthropic

if it raises a mountain of cash, a lot of that becomes orders for those same suppliers

so anthropic can steal their buyers this month and pay their invoices next year lmao

what i’m watching:

> the final IPO price
> coreweave earnings this week
> whether that debt insurance gets cheaper or keeps climbing
> whether chips and GPU rental stocks go up WITH anthropic or against it

if anthropic rips and the “friends” bleed, i wouldn’t read that as ai demand dying

wall street just finally got to date the one it wanted

UPDATE: Six weeks ago, I warned that the IRS was dramatically increasing the number of Letter 6174 notices being sent to crypto traders.

What we've seen since then is alarming.

Dozens more people, including our own clients, have contacted CryptoTaxAudit after receiving these exact letters.

This is no longer an isolated handful of cases. Based on the volume we're seeing, I believe the IRS is conducting another large-scale mailing campaign targeting crypto taxpayers.

Here's what you need to understand:

IRS Letter 6174 is a voluntary compliance letter. It means the IRS has information about your cryptocurrency activity and wants you to review whether you've met your tax reporting obligations.

It is NOT an audit.

In my view, these letters are designed to put pressure on crypto taxpayers to review their past filings and take corrective action.

But receiving one does not automatically mean you've done anything wrong.

DO NOT rush into amending tax returns or sending information to the IRS without understanding your position first.

Letters 6174 and 6174-A generally do not require a direct response, but you should review the instructions carefully.

Six weeks ago, I raised the alarm. The number of people contacting us since then has only reinforced my concerns.

Have you received an IRS Letter 6174 or 6174-A recently?

Comment below. I want to understand just how widespread this latest wave has become.

Please repost this. Crypto traders need to know what's happening.

author: JordanLyall
quoted_text:
We are delighted to announce that we will be presenting Tensile Forms by Emily Xie at Art Basel Miami 2026, Dec 2 – 6.

Tensile Forms is a series of embroidered works that combines generative art with textile craft.

Xie draws on the long, entwined history of textiles and computation, exploring the relationship between the hand and the machine—and what happens when a form made in code is translated into physical thread.

Beginning with an algorithm she crafted to generate unique biomorphic forms, Xie builds up her compositions using a multi-step collage process, selectively juxtaposing computationally textured patterns, shapes and colors to produce detailed images, ultimately rendered in embroidery.

The exhibition will include a series of large-scale works embroidered by hand, and a series of smaller works embroidered by machine. 

We are excited to share more details in the coming days.

text:
币安@binancezh边炉对话中文版核心总结来了，关于这次安全事件的各种疑问，看完这篇基本都有答案了

先介绍下对话参与人：

币安联合 CEO 一姐 @heyibinance、Richard Teng @_RichardTeng 

币安安全负责人 Jimmy

主持人 Jessica @jessicasmw

一、一姐回忆事发当晚

她本来准备睡觉，刷 X 时看到大家都在讨论币安是不是被黑了，立刻跳进工作 App，很多人已经在线。她不是技术出身，技术上帮不上忙，就先听着

当时社区开始恐慌，需要有人给答案。币安是 24 小时运营，PR、社交媒体、钱包运营和技术团队每个小时都有人值班。她站在用户角度想，大家最关心的就一件事：自己的钱安不安全

和主要股东、董事会简单沟通后，他们直接发了第一条帖，先把 "用户资金安全、币安会兜底" 的消息放出去，当时攻击其实还在进行

她特别感谢了 Tether、Circle、USD1 等稳定币公司，以及 Aave、Arbitrum、Polygon 等行业伙伴，几小时内就帮忙筹集资金

大家平时觉得加密行业很难合作，但那一刻她感受到的是互相支持

整个过程团队都很冷静，没人慌，只想怎么解决、怎么做得更好

 二、为什么币安也会被攻破

Jimmy 的回答很直接：币安被一个有耐心、资源充足的国家级背景攻击者盯上，攻击持续了好几个月

但他同时说，攻击复杂是事实，不能成为借口。更重要的是，币安有行业顶尖的安全团队，如果这种攻击能突破他们，也能突破大多数平台

攻击者不是只盯一家，他们在研究整个行业，所以这是全行业的问题，不是币安一家的事

三、用户资金到底安不安全

Richard 先给结论：用户资金安全，没有任何用户资金短缺。受影响的是币安自己的钱包、自己的头寸。

他解释了原因：

用户资金在独立的托管架构里，绝大多数在冷存储，只有用户提现时才动

没有发现私钥泄露，也没有用户数据泄露

币安拨出了超过 100% 的资金来覆盖损失

目前约 98% 受影响的代币已经补回，剩下 2% 是流动性差的资产，采购需要时间，但已经有安排兜底

他强调，大家不用只听他们说，可以自己通过储备金证明核对。答案不是一句承诺，是一个能自己检查的工具。币安成立九年半以来，客户保护一直是这么做的

四、暂停提现和 FTX 有什么区别

Richard 说理解大家会联想到 FTX，但这个比较不成立。

FTX 暂停提现，是因为客户的钱根本不在了；币安暂停，是预防性措施，为了保护本来就在的用户资金。而且币安几天内就恢复了服务，是在确认系统安全之后才开的

他的原话核心：为保护用户而暂停，是负责任；因为没办法才暂停，是另一回事。区别在于能不能验证，而不是听承诺

五、假招聘攻击是怎么回事

Jimmy 讲了具体过程：

9 月，一名软件工程师在正规招聘平台被人联系，对方冒充项目总监。因为他的资料里提到过在币安工作，这是定向攻击，不是随机撒网

第一轮是视频面试，对方冒充 HR，还分享了有个人照片和视频的社交账号来建立信任。第二轮在聊天软件上，对方冒充一家虚构公司的 CEO。面试快结束时，让他下载一个代码仓库到工作电脑，里面藏了恶意代码，安装时自动执行

这个恶意软件做了多层伪装，替换了合法开发工具的组件，能执行命令并和攻击者的服务器通信。它是零日恶意软件，第三方安全防护当时没检测出来，攻击者还会主动清除痕迹

Jimmy 说，这不是随机骗局，是针对人的耐心攻击，是所有行业、所有组织最难防的风险

六、这类威胁不是第一次

Jimmy 透露，2026 年到现在，安全团队已经检测并拦下了 57 起疑似朝鲜相关的网络攻击，手段包括假招聘、伪装成开发者工具的恶意软件、被入侵的软件包和浏览器插件、假会议软件、社会工程等

57 起拦住了，但不是全部，这是每个大平台现在都要面对的现实，所以行业协作不是可选项

七、为什么发现后钱还在继续流出

这是报告里很重要的一个教训

攻击者用的是交易授权机制，普通的暂停提现关不掉它。暂停提现只能停止新的提现请求，但攻击者已经拿到的授权在链上独立存在，不依赖币安系统运行

要止住血，得额外发链上交易去撤销这些授权。而币安的热钱包用的是多方计算（MPC），没有一把单独的私钥能立刻撤销，团队只能在极端时间压力下临时开发专门的撤销流程，所以整个遏制过程花了几个小时，而不是几分钟

他们公开这个细节，是因为用类似架构的平台都可能遇到同样的问题

八、AI 是风险还是优势

Richard 说不是二选一

AI 改变了攻击的成本：过去需要专业团队干的活，现在能自动化，速度更快、规模更大，社会工程也更逼真。但同一套技术也是最强的防御手段，能识别异常、追踪资金、快速响应

所以防御也得 AI 对 AI。币安会加大 AI 检测、行为监控和终端防护的投入，同时和外部 AI 公司、安全公司合作。安全对谁都做不到 100%，但对用户的责任是 100%

 九、为什么公开这么多技术细节

一姐说，法务团队建议公开报告别写这么细，但她拒绝了

她的理由是，币安上市快十年，社区信任的基础就是不隐瞒

犯了错就公开、承认、改进，把错误当成重建的机会。而且把细节讲清楚，能帮行业其他玩家明白发生了什么、自己该怎么防

她还讲了两个 HR 团队遇到的真事：有人面试时是一张脸，来办公室沟通时变成另一个人；还有人长着欧洲面孔、IP 却很奇怪，背景调查还没做完，对方就在入职前消失了。这种攻防每天都在发生。

十、已经做了什么，接下来怎么做

Jimmy 分了三段讲。

11 月 3 日前已经完成的：

在新环境重建受影响的钱包系统和内部 AI 工具，加强访问控制

替换受影响员工设备，撤销相关凭证

所有员工设备完成一轮增强安全扫描

加强 AI 行为异常检测和钱包风险控制

联合执法机构和区块链情报公司追踪、冻结资产

架构上的根本改动：

加强环境隔离，内外网流量分开，工作内容和敏感数据分开，设备上的文件存储和网络访问分开。目标是即使某一台员工设备被攻破，也没法升级成整个系统的事故

接下来三个重点：

1）请外部专家做独立安全审查，不自己审查自己

2）加大 AI 安全投入，把内部 AI 工具和开发者环境当成关键基础设施来管

3） 建立安全研究基金，联合 AI 公司和安全公司做行业协作，同时重新审视签名政策和热钱包控制

十一、给还不放心的用户

Richard 说了几点：

资金安全，从来没有出现过缺口，兜底不依赖追回进度

储备金证明随时可以自己查，不是让你光信一句话

会继续恢复更多网络和资产，独立审查结果也会公开

任何人都不会向你要密码、验证码或助记词，币安不会，遇到冒充的直接举报

十二、一姐对行业未来的看法

她先声明这是个人观点：黑客攻击现在几乎每天都有，但她依然看好加密行业，自己的资产也全是加密资产，没有留法币

她认为信任破了需要时间重建，但币安有经验 —— 之前合规问题很痛苦，他们重建了合规团队，现在币安的 KYC 是黄金标准；这次也会重建风控和安全系统

关于行业方向，她觉得是时候看真实价值了。今年币安的股票代币化业务增长很快，已经占到交易量的一半以上，RWA 业务在所有公链里也最活跃。

未来的方向是和传统金融合作，帮他们提高效率、降低成本，而不是只靠炒作。短期还有争议，但长期这会是币安的优势

信任不是靠嘴说的，是靠一次次做事攒回来的！

总结，大家什么都不用担心！继续跟着币安，一姐，表哥@cz_binance keep building 就行！

quoted_text:
Poki App 正式发布，可以非常自豪的告诉大家，Poki就是iPhone use的AGI.

从今天起，你的 iPhone 可以独立运行 AI Agent来控制你的手机。无需越狱，无需任何外部硬件。

Poki app核心解决了三个问题：响应速度、定位精度，以及长程任务的规划能力。

首先是闪电级的执行速度。
所有界面解析、截屏、触控与文本输入均在 iPhone 本地闭环完成，不再经过桌面端中转。任何重复流程均可固化为本地例程（Routine），后续触发无需调用大模型，直接以毫秒级原生速度重放。

其次是精准的长程规划。
Poki 面对跨应用的复杂多步任务，它会在每次交互后实时重判当前状态，彻底告别基于静态坐标的盲目操作。

对于支付、删除、输入密码等敏感操作，Poki会停下来并等待你的最终批准。

$GPUS: A BOLD MOVE TO ADDRESS SHAREHOLDER VALUE — AND A POTENTIAL TURNING POINT FOR HYPERSCALE DATA.

Sometimes the most important developments aren't about what a company has already accomplished. They're about the strategic decisions management makes to position the business for what comes next.

Hyperscale Data is making a statement.

The company intends to launch an exchange offer to purchase up to 192,307,692 shares of its Class A common stock, offering shareholders $2.00 in cash plus one preferred share with a stated value of $24.00 for every 100 common shares exchanged.

Let's look at what makes this announcement particularly significant.

1. Management is directly addressing the valuation disconnect.

Management believes the public market is not accurately recognizing the company's balance-sheet strength, including its cash and Bitcoin holdings. Rather than simply accepting the current market valuation, Hyperscale is proposing a corporate action intended to give shareholders another way to realize value.

2. A potential opportunity for shareholders.

The proposed exchange values the common shares at approximately $0.26 per share, representing an announced 82% premium to the November 6 closing price of $0.1429.

The proposed preferred stock also carries a 12% annual dividend, subject to its final terms and the company's ability to make dividend payments.

This creates an alternative investment proposition for shareholders who choose to participate.

3. A potentially meaningful long-term capital restructuring.

If successfully completed and the exchanged common shares are retired or cancelled, the transaction could reduce the outstanding common share count. That could improve the ownership position of remaining common shareholders and potentially strengthen future per-share economics.

4. Look beyond today's share price. Look at the bigger opportunity.

Hyperscale Data is positioning itself around an industry with enormous long-term infrastructure requirements: artificial intelligence.

AI requires computing capacity, data storage, power, sophisticated infrastructure and significant capital investment. The companies capable of developing and financing these assets could have opportunities as demand continues to expand.

The bigger investment question is whether Hyperscale can translate its balance-sheet resources, strategic financing initiatives and infrastructure investments into sustainable revenue growth and long-term shareholder value.

MY MESSAGE TO INVESTORS:

Don't evaluate a company's future exclusively through the lens of today's share price.

Evaluate its assets, capital allocation, financing strategy, execution, competitive positioning and ability to participate in the next generation of technological infrastructure.

This proposed exchange offer represents a consequential strategic move. It deserves serious attention.

The AI infrastructure opportunity is bigger than today's market sentiment. The challenge is execution, and the opportunity is creating lasting shareholder value.

$GPUS — Watch the strategy. Watch the execution. Watch the balance sheet. The next chapter could be important.

text:
看了老黄的出轨风波才知道，马斯克这种怪咖体质才是地表最强的防谍防火墙，

就算真给他派个顶级间谍，除了被迫听他通宵讲不锈钢火箭电焊和猛禽发动机参数，什么都挖不出来。

全场名流都在端着酒杯社交，只有马斯克在手舞足蹈地比划火箭升空，
派间谍去接近这种人简直是职业酷刑：你刚准备套近乎，他已经拉着你算了三个小时太空真空光速的物理账本。

传统谍战靠的是利用人性弱点撕开一道隐秘的口子：
灌几杯红酒、营造一点浪漫氛围、顺水推舟套出最关键的商业机密和政策底牌；

但如果你把这种经典剧本套在马斯克身上，整个情报体系的画风就会瞬间崩塌。

别人在烛光晚餐里聊风花雪月，马斯克能抓着你聊四个小时星舰不锈钢热防护瓦的铆接应力；

你试图打探下一代特斯拉或者 xAI 的核心商业机密，他转头就在 X 上发了十几条公开推文，把猛禽发动机的室压数据和火星移民发射窗口连图带字全网直接开源。

你通宵整理出来的绝密情报，甚至还没写进汇报备忘录，他已经在播客里当着全世界几千万人把底层物理账本讲了个一清二楚。

最让间谍崩溃的是他那种完全不可预测的怪咖体质。

在所有人盛装出席的名流酒会上，他能旁若无人地比划着火箭点火姿势、手舞足蹈地跟旁边人争辩太空太阳能的发电效能；

没有半点伪装的城府，没有被道德勒索的包袱，更没有可以被拿捏的暗箱把柄。

整个人就像一台全天候在公共网络上无差别广播的超级电台，没有任何加密信号，反而成了最坚不可摧的防火墙。

这里有一个极度冷酷的反直觉真相：
世界上最强大的情报防御，从来不是藏得有多深、嘴有多严，
而是掌舵人自己就是个把所有野心、疯话和底层代码毫无保留晒在阳光下的硬核技术狂。

别再费尽心机去挖什么内幕了，想从马斯克脑子里套秘密，
与其在酒桌上冒死潜伏，真不如直接在 X 上给他点个关注来得实在。

台北街头一段看似平常的私人聚餐画面，成了 CNN 这段 63 秒调查视频的悬念起点。

镜头里跟黄仁勋在餐厅外友好交谈、亲吻脸颊并同车离开的粉色衣服女子，被纽约时报记者保罗·莫祖尔直接点名：她叫 Alice Huang（黄乐），而在美方情报官员的备忘录里，她被怀疑是一条针对先进算力走向的情报接触渠道。

西方情报部门真正担忧的，并不是某个具体的芯片架构图纸，而是两层更深的信息穿透：
 一层是摸清黄仁勋本人在供应链和技术路线上的真实研判； 
另一层是借由他与华盛顿高层的深度对话，间接探查白宫对前沿 AI 芯片管制的政策底线。

CNN 在报道里特意留了一句退路：
他们尚未独立核实她的具体情报身份。

但这小段视频揭示了一个极度冷峻的现代情报战逻辑： 
在芯片每隔几个月就迭代一次的今天，费力去偷一张静态的电路图纸早就没有多大意义。

最值钱、也最无法防御的情报目标，已经彻底变成了能够接近核心决策者大脑的那条通道。

当一家科技公司的领袖掌握了全球算力分配的命脉，他日常的社交圈和人际边界，在情报机构眼里就已经是防线的一部分。

doing the past 6 months I've been helping design one of the stablecoin project in EU. 

Some of the things that tradfi players and regulators still ask:

- Opsec frameworks for managing assets. What should be the quorum for mint? How fast should it be?

- How to treat non custodial wallets and proof personhood / ownership for burning?

- How to connect KYC and KYT in single solutions? How can I react automatically to KYT?

- Why should I use HSM or MPC? What's the difference between the two?

- What's the a plan B if things go wrong with the chain? 

- What can go wrong with a smart contract update? what are patterns that do not disrupt integrators?

- What's the IP we can retain of open source contracts?

Problems that looks straightforward for a crypto audience are actually multi layered in tradfi, and this is true even before touching any use case or DeFi.

Charles Schwab, the largest U.S. retail brokerage, announced on November 9 that its Schwab Crypto platform has added spot trading for Solana (SOL), Avalanche (AVAX), and Chainlink (LINK), bringing its supported assets to five alongside BTC and ETH. The platform launched early access in May and opened to all eligible retail clients in October, charging a 0.75% trading fee. The service is currently available only to eligible customers in select U.S. states, excluding New York and Louisiana, and is not available outside the United States.

text:
With millions of people on Twitter, every day someone makes a prediction or a “market call.”  And out of all those people, every day SOMEONE is going to be right.
It’s like the lottery. Every week there’s a winner—but every week the name is different.
I’ve been succeeding in the stock market for 43 years. Not because I was a natural-born trader, and certainly not because I can predict the future. It’s the result of practice, study, discipline, patience, strategy, rules, experience—and being smart enough to never allow a prediction to get in the way of my respect for risk.
My entire fortune has been built on three key rules:
1. I never buy at the bottom.
2. I always sell too soon.
3. I never hold or add to losses.
That’s how you survive long enough to build a generational fortune. And for those smart enough to heed its wisdom, this tweet is worth a fortune.

Moods won't be your ordinary @opensea reveal. There are a couple of layers & ways you can play it.

🤙 METADATA 🤙
– Type is permanent. It has your typical rarity structure (Cosmic, Gold, Beef, etcc) that you come to expect from GVC. This dimension never changes.
– Moods also carry their first Expression (happy, sad, stoked, etc). These also have rarity, but they change dynamically 1x per day.

So effectively, you'll get a new reveal every day across the entire collection.

🤙 EXPRESSIONS 🤙
There are two optional ways to play the Expression layer. Think of it as a collector game.

– You can freeze a Mood to lock its expression (hold 100K $STOKED in its wallet). Each expression has a different rarity and "freeze cap" that controls the universal # possible. Some will have a cap of 10, some 20... others only 1-of-1. First come, first serve. Once the cap is reached no more can be frozen. 

– You can stone a Mood to permanently transform it (burn 1M $STOKED). This turns your Mood into a 1/1. Only 1 can exist per expression, first come first serve.

We like to use the Pokemon analogy a lot. There's a set of expressions loaded up in the pool to chase, and that set can dynamically expand over time. Giga rare expressions might remain undiscovered for a while (like a shiny green Onix), some as rare as 1 in 10,000.

Who knows what you might find! 👀

More Moods = more reveals each day, and more chances to find a grail or something ya love.

🤙 SNIPING 🤙
During most reveals, you just check what your hold and hawk what's listed on @opensea.

The big change here is the Anvil pool with @ClutchMarkets.

There are currently 1,239 Moods in the vault.

Those can all be freely sniped at reveal, both tomorrow and every day afterwards, using $STOKED (385K per snipe). Flip side, you can swap a Mood you're not vibing w/ back for $STOKED (315K) and use that to snipe something you like more.

Unlocks a whole new dimension of mobility, liquidity, and potential for collectors.

Happy hunting.

MAX STOKED!!!

LFV!!!!!!

Today we're launching @se3labs, backed by @ycombinator.

Robot models are getting better fast, but there's still a big gap between a great demo in sim or the lab and a robot that works reliably on a real task.

We're building real-world RL environments for robots. We start with tasks from industry partners, run policies on real robots, and find exactly where they fail. Those failures decide what data we collect and curate for the next policy update.

Next, we're bringing this to partner sites with physical sandboxes for real-world RL, so policies can train on the exact tasks and conditions they'll face in practice.

text:
@Samsung puts USDC in 82M US Galaxy wallets, Western Union bets on a stablecoin card as Q3 revenue falls 2%, @Stripe powers USDC deposits for @OnePay, and euro stablecoins grow 54% in a year.

Here are the most important developments in Digital Assets, Stablecoins, and RWAs 👇

1. Samsung Wallet adds USDC for 82 million US Galaxy devices.

Samsung went live with stablecoin accounts in Samsung Wallet on Thursday, letting eligible US Galaxy users buy, hold, send and receive USDC on Solana across about 82 million compatible devices. It’s built with custodian Bastion, with @Coinbase holding the USDC as sub-custodian.

2. Western Union pushes its stablecoin card as Q3 revenue falls 2%.

Western Union reported $1B in Q3 revenue, down 2% year over year on a slowdown in North America retail, and announced cuts of more than 650 roles. CEO Devin McGranahan pointed to growth bets instead: USDPT, its dollar stablecoin launched in May, and Stablecard, a USDPT-backed @Visa secured credit card launched in August. He pitched it at markets where consumers face currency volatility or limited access to dollars. The biggest name in remittances is now selling the thing disrupting it.

3. OnePay lets US customers fund checking accounts with USDC, powered by Stripe’s Bridge.

Walmart-backed OnePay now lets select US customers fund checking accounts with USDC across 12 blockchains, including Base, Solana, Ethereum and Tempo, with deposits converted into US dollars. Stripe-owned Bridge handles the deposit addresses, transaction monitoring and conversion, and OnePay charges no conversion fees at launch. The target is freelancers, gig workers and overseas employees already paid in stablecoins. The customer sees dollars. The stablecoin does the moving.

4. Euro stablecoins add $263M in a year while dollar stablecoin supply dips.

A DIA study of 140+ stablecoins across 25 currencies found euro stablecoin supply grew 54%, or $263M, in the year to 19 October, reaching $790M, while dollar stablecoin supply fell 1.3%. Euro stablecoin card spending hit $459M in the 12 months to September, more than five times the prior year, with EURC accounting for 80% of it. That’s 8.5% of traceable onchain stablecoin card spending from just 0.26% of total stablecoin supply. Small supply, outsized usage.

5. Nigeria’s central bank brings in stablecoin licensing and bans algorithmic stablecoins

The Central Bank of Nigeria’s new rules, live since November 5, require a license and per-token approval to issue stablecoins, and foreign-currency stablecoins must go through a locally incorporated issuer. Algorithmic stablecoins are banned outright. Dollar tokens now need a Nigerian entity behind them.

This is a MUCH bigger story than people realize.

In 1968, the NYSE literally CLOSED EVERY WEDNESDAY for months.

Why?

Wall Street was drowning in PAPER stock certificates.

By December, roughly $4 BILLION in securities deliveries were unsettled.

The crisis helped create the modern clearing infrastructure we still use today.

Fast forward to 2026...

An NYSE-affiliated platform plans to use Avalanche to settle tokenized stock trades 24/7, essentially instantly.

1792: 24 brokers organize under a buttonwood tree.

1968: Shut down Wall Street to catch up on paperwork.

2026: Move stock settlement onto a blockchain.

This is a major step toward 24/7 stock trading, including weekends and holidays, with near instant settlement (rather than the T+1 settlement cycle today).

The closing bell will be a thing of the past soon!

Dallas County provided voter rosters with the polling location where each voter cast a ballot for only two days of early voting. Those locations were later stripped from the first day’s roster and are now removed from the cumulative roster entirely.
Texas Election Code §129.003 requires an auditable paper trail. §127.302 and §127.201 require risk-limiting and hand-count audits. Federal law (HAVA, 52 U.S.C. §21081) requires a permanent paper record with manual audit capacity.
When the election department redacts the polling place where a voter voted under the Countywide Polling Place Program (§43.007), the chain of custody is broken. 
Ballot secrecy should not require erasing the location that makes an audit possible. But with Countywide voting it does.

text:
People living in the US don’t realize how important remittances are to the global economy. They're a financial lifeblood that keeps economies moving, especially in APAC. In Nepal, 33% of all GDP activity is remittances from Nepalese folks working abroad. In many countries, total remitted funds outstrip foreign aid.

Every day, foreign workers send money across borders. Loved ones in their home countries collect it as cash. These payments are deeply ingrained into community structures. In Mexico, @ElektraMX does billions in remittances along motorbike/scooter sales. In the Philippines, @kaCebuana is a remittance company distributed through 3,000 pawn shops.

The history of remittances is also the story of global economic development.

@WesternUnion launched money transfers via telegraph wire in 1871. Before that, it took weeks to move money across the country, let alone across the world. A hundred years later, we saw a shift towards electronic fund transfers, and the rise of competitors like @MoneyGram.

In the 21st century, peer-to-peer payment tools like @Revolut disrupted the picture once again. Today, stablecoins and crypto rails are being built into the infrastructure behind the global flow of remittances.

The story is still being written and I’m proud to be part of it through Fireblocks. If we make remittances more efficient, we benefit families, communities, and global GDP.
